games.name: Pears to Pairs Card Game
games.desc:
Welcome to Pears to Pairs, a simple, fun, and hilarious tabletop card game! 🍐

The rules for the game are simple. Each player is given a random set of cards that are objects/phrases. At the start of each round, a judge is selected along with a random card, an adjective. Your goal? Select a card that you think the judge will pair with their card to win! 🏆

With 1500+ different game cards and various game modes, you are sure to come up with crazy card combinations and have endless hours of fun! At least 3 players in a server are needed to play. 🎮

With full device cross compatibility, you can play the game on the go on your phone or tablet. Your cards and win stats also save between all devices and servers. Private servers are free to rent to play specifically with your friends! 📱

games.desc:
Welcome to Idiotic Investing, a multiplayer party type experience inspired by a Jackbox Party Pack 2 game!

✍️In Idiotic Investing with 4 or more players, you are given two pieces of paper to draw two separate topics on! Once every player has submitted their masterpiece, the bidding begins!✍️

💸At the start of every round, each player is given 3,000 credits to bid on other's art pieces. Once a player has successfully bid on a piece of art work, the true value of the piece will be revealed!💸

💰Short on Credits? You can gain more by auctioning off some of your art pieces or taking a loan from the Blox Bank! Be careful though, at the end of the game you have to pay a 50% interest fee on your loans.💰

🔩Want to annoy some of your friends? Half way through the round every player gains the abilty to screw a player and force them to bid once.🔩

So what are you waiting for? Invite some friends and let loose in the bidding!

games.name: Welcome to Roblox Building
games.desc:
A rewrite of "Welcome to Roblox Building", which was a sandbox building place hosted by Roblox around 2010-2016. 

This remaster of the game features more blocks, more baseplate customization, modernized interfaces, less exploits, save slots, and almost no limit to how much you can build!

This game is still a work in progress! Not all features have been fully polished and implemented yet. If you have any feedback, feel free to send a message to CloneTrooper1019! Thanks!
